whyNoLargeTreatmentCohortThisSession: Part 34 asks for 10-15 treatment pages. This session's own evidence (domain-pattern.json, brand-demand.json, authority-gap.json) converged on a domain-level, not page-level, explanation for most of the deep-ranking cohort -- meaning further per-page snippet/content edits on the remaining 29 competitive-cohort URLs would very likely repeat Phase IV's own finding (13 of 15 already correctly aligned, no safe edit identified) rather than produce a new, defensible improvement. Forcing a 10-15-page treatment cohort onto pages where the diagnosed problem is domain trust (not page content) would not be evidence-backed execution -- it would be exactly the 'SEO theater' this mission's own success criteria explicitly reject.
